versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the msModelSlim model analysis skill for Huawei Cloud.
- Analyze candidate models to determine implementation source (transformers or model-local) prior to adapter creation.
- Provide structured analysis of model type, architecture, layer structure, MoE fused weight risks, and adaptation feasibility.
- Supports assessment of decoder-only LLMs and VLM text backbones; does not support multimodal generation models.
- Requires model path and config.json as input; identifies missing files and guides user on next steps if analysis cannot proceed.
